blocks.title: uAccount: accounts and permissions
blocks.key_message: Simplify the steps while making the scope of user authorization clear.
blocks.speaker_explanation: Traditional wallets often require users to handle approvals, Gas and multiple actions separately. The whitepaper describes uAccount as using smart-account capabilities for permissions, batch transactions and programmable limits, enabling the execution system to act within user authorization. We aim for fewer steps and clearer permissions; specific account standards and permission designs can be discussed in more depth.
blocks.evidence_status: Architecture from the whitepaper; current documentation confirms smart contract accounts
blocks.boundary: The whitepaper references EIP-7702 + AA; do not assume an identical standard across every network. AA, MPC, ERC-4337 and EIP-7702 are not interchangeable terms.
blocks.pending_confirmation: Confirm per-chain account implementations, signing and recovery, delegated execution permissions, revocation, deployed contracts and corresponding audits.
blocks.technical_expansion: Industry context: account abstraction (AA) is a broad term for programmable account capabilities. EIP-7702 allows EOAs to delegate code; ERC-4337 defines a system including UserOperations, bundlers and paymasters. These standards alone do not prove that UXUY uses every component.

blocks.title: Smart routing and AI: from intent to execution
blocks.key_message: Routing optimizes how a trade executes; it does not predict whether an asset price will rise.
blocks.speaker_explanation: A trade may have routes across different chains, venues and liquidity sources. The router compares available liquidity, quotes, slippage, network fees and route conditions to form an executable plan. Project materials describe AI-assisted execution optimization. Current public documentation directly confirms automatic routing and the dimensions it compares.
blocks.evidence_status: Automatic routing is documented; AI implementation details need verification
blocks.boundary: Do not claim AI guarantees the best price or profits, or that every AI model is developed in-house. Pathfinding does not automatically mean machine learning. Trade Agent is not another name for smart routing.
blocks.pending_confirmation: Confirm whether AI handles search, ranking, prediction or order splitting; models, inputs and outputs; live execution safeguards, failure fallbacks and performance benchmarks.
blocks.technical_expansion: Industry context: routes may be compared by expected received value minus total costs, or selected subject to slippage and latency constraints. Splitting an order can reduce price impact but increase Gas. Conditions can change between quote and execution.

blocks.title: ULP: where liquidity comes from
blocks.key_message: The whitepaper describes ULP as providing base liquidity, alongside market making and hedging.
blocks.speaker_explanation: Trading markets need executable counterparties and depth. blocks.speaker_explanation: Trades execute at prices actually available in the market. Mark price is used for unrealized P&L and risk calculations, not as a guaranteed execution price. Index price aggregates valid reference markets. Funding is exchanged between longs and shorts to help keep the contract price near the underlying market. Falling below maintenance margin may trigger liquidation; insurance funds and ADL address subsequent extreme losses.

audiences.opening: UXUY is a 100% stablecoin-denominated on-chain exchange backed by YZi Labs. Users can invest in global assets with USDT, USDC and UUSD. Our work today is to make “Trade global assets with U” a simpler everyday experience.
script: UXUY is a 100% stablecoin-denominated on-chain exchange backed by YZi Labs. Users can invest in global assets with USDT, USDC and UUSD.

For the community, this means users can start with familiar stablecoins and access the assets and markets currently supported. We want to reduce switching between chains, Gas tokens and complex steps, so people can focus more on trading itself.

To do that, we continue developing accounts, multichain execution, Gas handling, smart routing and an in-house Perp DEX. Eligible trades can reduce the need to prepare separate Gas tokens. Users should always review the relevant markets, fees and rules before trading.

Our longer-term direction is a more open, transparent and verifiable on-chain market, with clearer user control over accounts and permissions. The community can contribute through real product experience, feedback and education, helping advance this stablecoin trading approach together.
outline_3min: Opening: the updated UXUY definition and stablecoin denomination.
Problem: why multichain workflows, Gas and fragmented markets still create barriers for stablecoin users.
Product: explain one currently supported trade, adding GasLess and smart routing where relevant.
Vision: openness, transparency and user control; distinguish current development from long-term goals.
Close: offer one available product entry point or a concrete feedback action.
faq: What does 100% stablecoin-denominated mean?

Stablecoins are the starting point for the trading and funding experience. Explain denomination, margin, settlement and conversion for each current market. “100%” does not mean there are no third parties anywhere in the process.
Why can GasLess still involve fees?
GasLess has eligibility conditions. Trading fees, network costs, slippage and Perp funding are different items. The confirmation screen and applicable rules determine the details.
Can I buy every global asset?
Global assets describes our development direction. Current trading covers the assets and markets already available. Access also depends on region, account and current product support.
Is UXUY already fully decentralized?

We are working toward greater openness, transparency and user control. Accounts, execution, permissions and stock custody each have current arrangements. We explain what has been implemented and what may open further.
Can the AI invest automatically for me now?
Smart routing and an autonomous Trade Agent are separate. Current public materials directly support automatic routing; Trade Agent availability requires separate confirmation.
audiences.next_step: Try one currently available feature and record feedback on the steps, fees or execution. Organizers can then discuss education and community contributions.

Interface availability depends on current access and your use case. First specify the goal, assets and networks; the technical team can then provide available documents, permissions and integration options.
What underlies the in-house Perp DEX?

Core areas include orders and margin, liquidity, prices, settlement and risk management. The whitepaper describes ULP as supplying base liquidity, alongside market making and hedging. Specific matching, oracles and deployment should be reviewed using a current technical diagram.
How can AI routing value be measured?
Assess total execution cost, slippage, success rate and response time. Execution optimization is not a guarantee of returns.

audiences.opening: Through uStock, we aim to help listed companies connect with global on-chain investors, broaden their investor base, access stablecoin capital and build ongoing on-chain trading and attention.
script: Through uStock, we aim to help listed companies connect with global on-chain investors. These investors understand stablecoins and on-chain trading and may want access to more real businesses and assets. For a company, this offers a new path to broaden its investor base, reach new capital and expand international awareness.

The value includes introducing the company to more investors across regions, connecting with stablecoin capital through eligible issuance, and planning post-issuance trading and liquidity together. Where service arrangements support it, on-chain markets may also provide a 24/7 participation window, enabling investors to stay engaged while traditional markets are closed.

uStock aims to connect these opportunities into a long-term partnership: from investor outreach to issuance, then subsequent trading, information and community participation. UXUY’s user foundation and ecosystem support the search for practical participation use cases.
We can begin with your company’s priority: new investors, funding, global communications or subsequent market activity. From there, we can discuss suitable shares and onboarding arrangements.
outline_3min: Needs: whom the company wants to reach and which capital or market opportunities it seeks.
Core value: new investors, stablecoin capital, subsequent trading and liquidity, on-chain participation windows, international awareness and long-term attention.
Evidence: the roles of uStock, UXUY and UUSD; relevant background, funding and user data with disclosure definitions.
Partnership: ongoing market development and investor communication after issuance, choosing services that fit the company’s goals.
Action: schedule a specific needs discussion; explore shares, custody, rights and closing when the company is ready.
faq: Why connect with on-chain investors?

It can help a company reach investors who hold capital in stablecoins and are comfortable participating on-chain, extending existing investor coverage. The proposal is designed around the business, asset rights and participation needs.
What value is there beyond fundraising?
Global awareness, investor relations, subsequent on-chain trading and liquidity use cases, and a 24/7 participation window where service arrangements support it. Fundraising is one possible goal.
Do we need to become a crypto company first?
Start with the shares, commercial goals and structural feasibility. The onboarding proposal will specify the company’s technical, financial and disclosure obligations.
Are uToken holders our registered shareholders?
The materials describe economic rights in custodial shares, not automatic direct registered shareholder status. They explicitly exclude voting rights. The specific legal documents govern.
Who holds the shares and who is responsible for issuance?

That depends on listing jurisdiction, share source and the proposed structure. Feasibility assessment identifies the custodian, shareholding and issuing entities, and each party’s responsibilities, to be reflected in formal documents.
Can you guarantee fundraising or a higher share price?
No. Share issuance, subscription closing, liquidity and market pricing must be discussed separately.
Does 24/7 trading mean shares can be redeemed at any time?
Trading hours are distinct from eligible redemption, custody and traditional-market closing arrangements. Explain each separately.
Which listed-company issuances have already been completed?

Existing materials describe preparation for the Genesis issuance and discussions with issuers. Any completed and publicly disclosable closing must be confirmed against the latest business progress before being cited.
